title: Severe allergic reaction
plain: Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing. Epinephrine first: every minute counts.

steps.text: Inject epinephrine into your outer thigh now
steps.detail: Through clothing is fine. An expired injector is still better than none.

steps.text: Lie down with your legs raised. If breathing is hard, sit up instead.

steps.question: Is breathing easier and has the swelling stopped growing?

steps.text: Take an antihistamine for the itch and hives
Stay near others for 4 hours and keep a second injector with you: it can come back.

escalation: Still struggling to breathe after 2 injections: put on oxygen and follow EMG-SEVERE-ALLERGY. The crew and Earth were alerted when you started.
